Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```
Read in data
```{r}
Dev <- read.csv("data/Kyn2/Kyn2Development.csv")
Key <- read.csv("data/Kyn2/Kyn2BottleKey.csv")
Key$Start<-paste(Key$DateStarted,Key$TimeStarted)
```

```{r}
Key2<-Key%>%select("Bottle","NEggs","Geno","Treatment","Start")
Dev<-merge(Key2,Dev,by="Bottle")
```


```{r}
Dev$Start <- as.POSIXct(Dev$Start, format = "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M %p")
Dev$Observed<-paste(Dev$Date,Dev$Time)
Dev$Observed <- as.POSIXct(Dev$Observed, format = "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M %p")
```


```{r}
# Calculate the time passed in hours
Dev$Hours <- as.numeric(difftime(with(Dev, Observed), 
                                            with(Dev, Start), 
                                            units = "hours"))
#Dev$Hours<-as.factor(Dev$Hours)
# Calculate the final total for each "Bottle"
final_totals <- Dev %>%
  group_by(Bottle) %>%
  summarise(Final_Total_males = sum(MalePupae),
            Final_Total_females = sum(FemalePupae),
            Final_Total_sexed = sum(MalePupae,FemalePupae),
            Final_Total_pupae = sum(Pupae))

final_totals_treat <- Dev %>%
  group_by(Geno,Treatment) %>%
  summarise(Final_Total_males = sum(MalePupae),
            Final_Total_females = sum(FemalePupae),
            Final_Total_sexed = sum(MalePupae,FemalePupae),
            Final_Total_pupae = sum(Pupae))

final_totals2 <- Dev %>%
  group_by(Bottle) %>%
  summarise(Geno=Geno,
            Treatment=Treatment,
            Final_Total_males = sum(MalePupae),
            Final_Total_females = sum(FemalePupae),
            Final_Total_sexed = sum(MalePupae,FemalePupae),
            Final_Total_pupae = sum(Pupae))
final_totals2<-distinct(final_totals2)

```

```{r}
# Calculate the cumulative sum and proportion based on final total
cumulative_data_bottle <- Dev %>%
  group_by(Bottle, Location) %>%
  arrange(Bottle, Location, Hours) %>%
  mutate(Cumu_N_M = cumsum(MalePupae),Cumu_N_F = cumsum(FemalePupae),Cumu_N_P = cumsum(Pupae)) %>%
  left_join(final_totals, by = "Bottle") %>%
  mutate(ProportionMofM = Cumu_N_M / Final_Total_males,
         ProportionMofTotal = Cumu_N_M / Final_Total_sexed,
         ProportionFofF = Cumu_N_F / Final_Total_females,
         ProportionFofTotal = Cumu_N_F / Final_Total_sexed,
         ProportionP = Cumu_N_P / Final_Total_pupae)

cumulative_data <- Dev %>%
  group_by(Geno,Treatment,Location) %>%
  arrange(Geno, Treatment,Location, Hours) %>%
  mutate(Cumu_N_M = cumsum(MalePupae),Cumu_N_F = cumsum(FemalePupae),Cumu_N_P = cumsum(Pupae)) %>%
  left_join(final_totals_treat, by = c("Geno","Treatment")) %>%
  mutate(ProportionMofM = Cumu_N_M / Final_Total_males,
         ProportionMofTotal = Cumu_N_M / Final_Total_sexed,
         ProportionFofF = Cumu_N_F / Final_Total_females,
         ProportionFofTotal = Cumu_N_F / Final_Total_sexed,
         ProportionP = Cumu_N_P / Final_Total_pupae)

cumulative_data_noLoc <- Dev %>%
  group_by(Geno,Treatment) %>%
  arrange(Geno, Treatment, Hours) %>%
  mutate(Cumu_N_M = cumsum(MalePupae),Cumu_N_F = cumsum(FemalePupae),Cumu_N_P = cumsum(Pupae)) %>%
  left_join(final_totals_treat, by = c("Geno","Treatment")) %>%
  mutate(ProportionMofM = Cumu_N_M / Final_Total_males,
         ProportionMofTotal = Cumu_N_M / Final_Total_sexed,
         ProportionFofF = Cumu_N_F / Final_Total_females,
         ProportionFofTotal = Cumu_N_F / Final_Total_sexed,
         ProportionP = Cumu_N_P / Final_Total_pupae)
cumulative_data_noLoc<-cumulative_data_noLoc%>%select(-Location)
cumulative_data_noLoc<-distinct(cumulative_data_noLoc)

```

```{r}
final_totals2%>%group_by(Treatment,Geno) %>%
summarise(
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Geno=Geno,
    TotalF = sum(Final_Total_females, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalM = sum(Final_Total_males, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalP = sum(Final_Total_pupae, na.rm = TRUE),
    )->TotalP
TotalP<-distinct(TotalP)

TotalP$Ratio<-TotalP$TotalF/TotalP$TotalM

```


```{r}
write.csv(cumulative_data_bottle, "data/Kyn2/Kyn2 DevTime.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cumulative_data, "data/Kyn2/Kyn2 DevTime2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cumulative_data_noLoc, "data/Kyn2/Kyn2 DevTime3.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
